annotation.interpretation_a: An endpoint is encouraged to discard keys when the condition is met, but it is permissible to retain them.
annotation.interpretation_b: An endpoint is expected to discard keys when the condition is met, but failure to do so is not an error.
annotation.justification: The use of 'SHOULD' creates ambiguity. It is unclear whether discarding the keys is merely recommended or expected. A 'MUST' would have removed the ambiguity.
